names.description: Cloud names set in full (not Terraform variables; docs/design.md, "Names, labels and tags"). A name set here takes no prefix; one not set derives as fabric derives it.

firewall.description: The SSH firewall rule's name in full.

namePrefix.description: Optional convenience (not a Terraform variable): <namePrefix>- in front of every derived cloud name, never one set under names. A DNS label. Empty changes nothing.

labels.description: Kubernetes labels on every object; an unprefixed key also becomes a Google Cloud label (Config Connector copies it to the instance's labels).

tags.description: Cloud labels on every resource (Google Cloud labels: lower-case letters, digits, _ and -).

firewall_create.description: Create Network firewall rules to enable SSH.

ip_allocation.description: Ip allocated for datafusion instance when not using the auto created one and created outside of the module.

ip_allocation_create.description: Create Ip range for datafusion instance (refused when true).

network_peering.description: Create Network peering between project and DataFusion tenant project (refused when true).

type.description: Datafusion Instance type. It can be BASIC or ENTERPRISE (default value).
